memoryRule: a first word becomes a latent witness; a different reply keeps both words exact while a remote word is replaced, another splits, and another echoes; four inferences compound
interactionRule: pointer or touch touches one word, then a different distant word; Enter, Space, and the inference control use a deterministic pair; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: continuous Canvas relief, cellular raster plate, and cut-out field -> browser-native typographic sentence made from actual text buttons
compositionRupture: single mould body, dense raster plate, and off-axis aperture -> scattered oversized sentence with unstable baselines and open dark ground
encounterRupture: press-and-cross, mark-and-commit, and hold-and-leave -> two-word witness/reply relation inside language
temporalRupture: material hardening, cellular miscount, and departure absence -> latent first word followed by discrete reply and persistent remote mishearing
mediumRupture: p5.js Canvas 2D relief, p5.js raster cells, and Canvas cut-outs -> browser-native DOM text, buttons, CSS positioning, and actual text substitution
changedRule: The first word is only latent evidence. A different reply leaves both witnessed words geometrically exact and makes the model mishear three remote words as substitution, split phrase, and echo.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a scattered typographic sentence. A valid relation changes actual remote text, position, scale, rotation, tracking, and echo while both witnesses remain exact; four inferences persist.
falsifier: Delete if a word answers itself, if the first touch mutates geometry, if remote roles are cosmetic, if the blind field reads as a generic poster or node diagram, if later inferences reset, or if exact lifting fails.
deletionCondition: Delete v041 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the sentence from v038-v040 or if the two-word relation does not materially change remote text and layout.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
